# The first shape, in the spelling the release gate carried: a program named on
# the same line as the file it is handed. The vocabulary is what sees this one,
# and the file it is refused for is on the same line as the tool.
      - name: Read the metadata
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="$(awk -v key=version -f "${RUNNER_TEMP}/read_scalar.awk" build.yaml)"
          echo "::notice::build.yaml declares ${version}."
